repairs.disposition: Source-established correction to analyst countermodel: editing is insufficient; require matching receipt.

range: Recorded initially-supported check plus full deliberate defect/repair/restoration episode. No prior failure is required to obtain support. No deployment universality.
limits: This historical prototype used runtime correspondence snapshots; it does not require runtime catalog checks in the planned evidence system.
No deployment, auth, browser ordering, or whole-module effect claim.
abstraction: Evidence-work process; application execution is an observed check result, not simulated database behavior.
event_wording: Action granularity and short names are analyst choices; observations retain source references.
state_semantics: Guards are AND clauses, with OR across clauses. A replay event has enabled, occurring and accomplished-but-not-depleted phases. Phase expansion is a modeling convention, not measured timing. Repeated checks are new occurrences; evidence is reusable, not consumed by being read.

decision.quote: no — code isn't the only thing used in tests
decision.scope: Code reversion and test evidence; rubric-only reassessment remains R19.
